desc: Office, newsroom, someone working. Texture that says occupied.
prompt: fingers typing quickly on a mechanical keyboard, individual plastic keys bottoming out with a sharp click and a hollow case resonance, irregular pace, occasional pause, close microphone, dry
negative: music, speech, rhythm, drums, typewriter, reverb
note: PARTIAL: no sync and no control of pace - the keystrokes will not match anything on screen. Fine as texture in a wide or off-camera; if hands are in frame, cut one keystroke out and place them by hand. 'typewriter' is in the negative because mechanical-keyboard prompts drift to a typewriter mechanism and hand you a carriage return you did not ask for.
